notes.title: NeoPiano - Update 1.5 is out !
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.5 is out ![/h1]

Hi ! This update mainly add a new feature that allows you to detect the current chords you're playing. I've also added a new General Setting menu where you can customize every input of the piano keys and change the graphics settings. A pitch offset feature has also be added : you can use the arrows on your keyboard to offset the keys you're playing by one or an octave.

There is a non exhaustive list of changes :
[list]
[*] Main Menu -> Fullscreen / Windowed toggle button on bottom right.
[*] Main Menu -> Key Tab -> Added Chord Detection feature activation checkbox.
[*] General Settings access button on bottom right of the main menu.
[*] General Settings menu with two tabs, Input and Graphics.
[*] General Settings -> Input Settings : Customization of inputs and shortcuts (Pitch, Sustain, Keys)
[*] General Settings -> Input Settings : New pitch offset feature.
[*] General Settings -> Graphic Settings : Modify the FPS limit, Windowed mode and graphics quality.
[/list]

notes.title: NeoPiano - Update 1.4 is out !
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.4 is out ![/h1]

Hi ! This update contains big fixes on the MIDI player and some new features and customization.
There are two new background, the water one represent an ocean and the pad one is a proof of concept to make input based background.

There is a non exhaustive list of changes :
[list]
[*] A new MIDI File parser (You can now import any MIDI file).
[*] New kind of "Neon" : Crystal Style.
[*] 2 New background as proof of concept : Water and Pad
[*] A new setting to enable stickers on the keys to help the qwerty players. Available in key tab settings
[*] A new kind of input mode for qwerty player. Also available in key tab settings
[*] An ambiant light can be enable in the background tab.
[*] Fixed velocity blending disabled bug.
[*] Your last used midi devices are now saved automatically as for the new qwerty input mode 
[/list]

notes.title: NeoPiano - Update 1.3.1 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Hi ! Update 1.3.1 is mostly bug fixes from Update 1.3.[/b]

- The neons did not stop growing if two MIDI pressed events were send without being released. 
- Sustain pedal wasn't working properly in some cases.

I've also add a slider to select the default velocity (mainly for qwerty players) and it come with setting to override any velocity input to this default value. These settings are on the Sound tab.

See you soon !

notes.title: NeoPiano - Reverse Mode Update !
notes.content:
[h1]There is now a reverse mode for NeoPiano ![/h1]
To activate it, go to the [b]Keys[/b] tab and enable it from the [b]Reverse Mode[/b] section.

This update includes [b]2 new tail styles[/b] with a new, cleaner default style !
There are also [b]2 neon lines[/b] on the keyboard and at the location of the neon generation which can be enabled as you wish. It can add some light on your screen !

[i]Note: There is no training mode yet but it is still on my task board and is planned for an upcoming update.[/i]

I hope you will like it ! 

The next update might be about adding presets and smooth transition between them. I will also focus on the MIDI player which unfortunately is not yet able to load any type of MIDI files.

See you later ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474545/caf8c2cb4f71d6b671fab91b8a7668293e5d1610.png[/img]

notes.title: NeoPiano - Background Update !
notes.content:
[h1]You can now use your own material textures for NeoPiano's background !
[/h1]
To do this, go to the [b]Background [/b]tab and select "[b]Custom...[/b]" from the Material drop-down list.

Then you can edit the textures used for your materials.

[i]Warning : If you're using a non square image, the texture will be stretch, to prevent this, please edit the size of your image before loading it. For exemple, if you need a 1920x1080 background, please resize the picture to 1920x1920. We might automate this process later for a next update.
[/i]
You can try textures from free-3dtextureshd.com or polyhaven.com for free !

Also, This update should reduce latency issue on NeoPiano's sound system.

Next update will focus on reverse falling neons and learning mode ! 

See you later ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42474545/2c0f990277ba9d6ed2f4a36d5d97ec5fa10f2364.png[/img]
